title: The position and rotation Jacobians of NodeUser, ObjectUserBody and MarkerBodyUser by central differences
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.17: when their Jacobian functions are missing, the three user items compute the position and rotation Jacobians by central differences, so a joint on them gets a partly numerical constraint Jacobian - nowhere else in Exudyn. To be decided (tbd): require the Jacobian functions, at least when a joint uses the item, and keep central differences only behind an exudyn.special flag with its dangers documented. Kept as it is for now.
releaseNotes: NodeUser, ObjectUserBody and MarkerBodyUser need their position Jacobian function, and with the orientation their rotation Jacobian function, where a connector or joint uses them through a marker; Assemble refuses them without, naming the item. The Jacobians are no longer approximated by central differences; a user item without connectors, such as a user beam with markers only on its nodes, needs none.
